messages:
dan: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7123 is ready but blocked on arch signoff. CI is green on my branch.
maria: quick skim looks reasonable. main thing is we need to confirm fallback routing semantics match the RFC before we merge.
priya: which RFC are we gating on? can you paste the link?
dan: RFC here: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/2026-03-prefetch-routing — specifically section 3.2 about variant fallback.
cheng: left 3 inline comments on the PR (metrics tags, trace propagation, and a minor nit in the test). none are blockers imo.
dan: @cheng thanks — I'll address those. planning to merge Wed EOD if arch ok.
arch-team-bot: New RFC review requested: https://docs.redwood.ai/reviews/987 — reviewers: @pranav, @elena
pranav: I'll pick this up tomorrow. quick question: does the PR introduce any new runtime flags or defaults for Dedicated customers?
maria: tests: unit + integration pass. marked e2e as flaky (ticket R-231) — that won't block merge if arch signs off and we gate behind a feature flag.
priya: prefer an explicit opt-in flag for the rollout so we can toggle per-customer during the canary.
dan: added env flag REDWOOD_ENABLE_PREFETCH_ROUTING=false by default and pushed commit.
cheng: re-reviewed after the flag change — LGTM from my side. @pranav can you confirm RFC alignment and rollout notes?
pranav: skimmed the RFC, left a small comment about staged rollout percentages and monitoring thresholds. not blocking. RFC ack from me once that note is incorporated.
dan: I'll add the rollout percentage config and a short monitoring checklist in the PR description.
maria: :thumbsup: also please add a note in the console docs pointing to the RFC.
dan: will do. thanks all — merging after final CI and RFC ack.
deploy-bot: Merge queued for PR #7123. All required checks must pass before automatic merge.
maria: :shipit:
priya: thanks everyone, great async flow.
